title: Under the counting house
lines: dm

Marrow Street is empty at night. Under the Counting House a stone stair ends at a vault door covered in frost. The air is cold enough to hurt your teeth, and the frost crackles where you step near it.
a
Isolde presses her hand to the door and says, "It is humming. I can feel it in my teeth."
dm
The hum is low and steady against her palm. Carved runes run in a ring around the lock.
b
Garrick reads the runes aloud, slowly. "These warn of a curse," he says.
dm
As he finishes, frost races across Isolde's glove. The leather stiffens, and the cold bites hard: four points of cold damage. She loses all feeling in two fingers.
a
Isolde snatches her hand back and says, "That hurt. Open it, Garrick."
b
Garrick burns a scroll of warding against the door and says, "Stand back."
dm
The scroll flares with a smell of hot paper. The hum fades to silence, and the door swings open on a room of stacked coins that glitter in the lantern light.
a
Isolde takes a single gold ring from the top of a pile.
dm
The ring is cold and heavy. Behind you the door begins to swing shut, and something scrapes in the dark.
b
Garrick shouts, "Isolde, take my hand!" and reaches back for her.
dm
He catches her sleeve and drags her through the gap, and the door shuts with a boom that shakes dust from the ceiling.
dm
The street is silent. A thin whisper comes from the ring, though no one is speaking.
